instruction: CTAの出来レース感を解消。本文の『提携先』『広告提携』文言は禁止、広告表記は本文と独立した『広告（PR）』として明示する。
scope: Three already-published article CTA redesigns. User has NOT yet approved redesigned previews. Do not merge before new preview approval.
rules: Start from real reader problem; don't insert ads as the purpose of the page.
Give an actionable comparison or decision criterion before any CTA.
Explain who the service suits, who should choose another method, and what to verify before applying.
Never claim author used an unused service or imply paid entries rank above the 58 independently researched services.
Avoid 『提携先』『広告提携』 in editorial body. Keep separate visible PR disclosure, and rel=nofollow sponsored for tracked links.
Respect ASP banner creative (ZEN 120x60) without inventing an unapproved text link.
At most one CTA per relevant article except genuine role-based multi-service comparisons.
Preserve original media, dates of publication, article URLs, and avoid diagnosis CTA.
